source.title: Experimental study of ignited unsteady hydrogen releases from a high pressure reservoir
source.reported_case: 0.37 dm3 reservoir, 4 mm nozzle, 200 bar initial pressure

reported_anchors.source_basis: text accompanying Figure 2; measured/calculated pressure-decay comparison

eligibility.reason: The public source supplies textual timing anchors and a plot, but no complete machine-readable measured pressure-time series or trace-specific uncertainty metadata required by the frozen holdout protocol.

claim_boundary: Use only as source-context diagnostics and a lead for controlled raw-data access. Do not claim an independent validation pass or station-scale safety, ignition, dispersion, or SAGA-effectiveness evidence from these anchors.
